_about: Public-domain Robert Flint (1838-1910, Church of Scotland, Edinburgh) for the Word Hoard: Theism, the Baird Lecture for 1876 (Project Gutenberg, first edition 1877), and from Internet Archive scans Anti-Theistic Theories (1879), Agnosticism (1903), Christ's Kingdom upon Earth (1865), Christian Unity (1878), Sermons and Addresses (1899) and On Theological, Biblical, and Other Subjects (1905). His philosophy-of-history volumes are alternates. Added 2026-10-10 by lane A, round 19 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
